archive/entry#

Immutable archive member values, with already-bound paths and metadata.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let entry = ArchiveFile(path, metadata, [byte(0), byte(255)]);
entry.data();       // exact bytes, repeatable, no I/O
entry.accept(to);   // exactly one to.file(entry) event

Description#

Immutable archive member values, with already-bound paths and metadata. No filesystem reads, extraction, link resolution, permission changes or device creation. File data is an immutable byte snapshot already in memory; aggregate limits belong to the archive reader. No owned resources.

Only ArchiveFile has data(). Links have target(); devices have major/minor. A symbolic target is relative to the link's parent; a hard target is relative to the archive root. Both use the strict ArchivePath grammar: no absolute or parent-traversing targets. This subset neither resolves links nor proves safe extraction. Cycles, existence and destination containment are checked later.

accept() passes the concrete value unchanged to one nominal visitor action. The visitor controls effects, may retain entries, and its errors propagate. Repeated accepts repeat the event without consuming data or traversing links. The role fake emits an empty file named entry with UTC epoch metadata.

role ArchiveEntryVisitor#

role ArchiveEntryVisitor

Typed variant dispatch for consumers of heterogeneous ArchiveEntry values. These actions receive concrete values, so no reflection/downcast is needed to obtain file bytes, link targets or device numbers.
